title: 修复只读根探测与扫描的联接边界
risks: This bounded component fix rejects static linked roots/ancestors and deterministic directory-to-junction replacement between enumeration yields; it does not remove the check-to-use race between metadata checks and operating-system calls.

Ordinary-directory identity replacement, other physical-root aliases and non-cooperative Linux namespace mutation remain unproven. Production scanning still needs no-follow/handle-based access evidence and supervised Worker isolation; existing release and write gates are unchanged.

Synchronous filesystem metadata calls cannot forcibly cancel a stalled kernel/NAS call. Added ancestor checks cost O((entry count + directory count) * ancestor depth) metadata queries; no real 500,000-asset NAS latency/capacity evidence was produced.
The new filesystem regressions ran on Windows with directory junctions. The Linux symbolic-link branch was not executed in this task, and a successful Windows run is not Linux platform evidence.

Initial fixture-cleanup failures left seven file-free fixture roots and two empty child directories under this worktree's ignored sandbox. Two cleanup commands were rejected by automatic approval review with the reason 'blocked by policy'; they were not executed or retried through another interface. Exact residual paths are retained in tests.md.

architecture_review.module: LibraryStorage.Infrastructure root probe and ScanReconciliation.Infrastructure read-only discovery; owner: library-asset-scan-owner
reused_existing_logic: ILibraryRootProbe and LibraryRootValidationService retain the existing Inaccessible result path, canonical-root value and overlap policy; no registration or identity policy is reimplemented.
IReadOnlyFileDiscovery, FileDiscoveryException and InitialReadOnlyScanService retain staged observation abort, terminal journaling, cancellation, timeout and structured failure logging.
DefaultDiscoveryPolicy and existing entry classification keep unchanged child reparse directories visible without recursion, with streaming enumeration and bounded observation batches.

RepositorySandbox, TestObservationSink, TestScanJournal and TestTargetQuery provide isolated filesystem fixtures and the existing scan application test ports; .NET 10/C# 14, MSTest and locked dependencies remain unchanged.
duplicated_logic: Each owning Infrastructure adapter performs a small ancestor-attribute walk with its existing error semantics. This intentional adapter-local repetition avoids a cross-module Infrastructure dependency or an unowned filesystem utility layer, as specified in ALIGN-002; no application, permission, identity or state-machine logic is duplicated.
cross_module_access: The production diff adds no cross-module references. ScanReconciliation continues to use only the existing LibraryStorage and AssetIdentity public contracts; LibraryStorage and ScanReconciliation do not reference one another's Infrastructure.

No Domain/Application/Host implementation, database table, migration, permission model, shared wire contract or generated SDK is changed. Test-only composition uses the existing public ports and concrete adapters.
contract_changes: No public type, field, wire schema, generated SDK or migration changes. The existing FileDiscoveryException.FailureCode path now reports directory_reparse_point, directory_unavailable or directory_metadata_failed for the new physical-directory checks; InitialReadOnlyScanService uses its unchanged DiscoveryFailed/abort contract.
architecture_tests: ReadCore MSTest: 51 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, including eight new boundary cases; controlled pre-fix reproduction had 6 failed and 1 passed before the EOF case was added.
Architecture rule tests: 14/14; AssetLink contract/spike tests: 21/21; 86 unique final test cases total.
Locked restore, format verify, Release build with 0 warnings/errors and source validation over 209 C# files passed; architecture baseline passed over 114 inputs.
production-file-writes remains blocked by M0-006-G2 with native exit code 3. Gate files are unchanged; this is expected negative evidence, not a release pass.
Final handoff structure, declared changed-file list and whitespace are checked separately; exact commands and results are recorded in tests.md.
technical_debt: The library-asset-scan-owner must provide no-follow/handle-based identity and namespace mutation evidence before claiming safe production scanning under non-cooperative path changes.
Retain V01-004's follow-up requirement for supervised isolation of synchronous filesystem calls and real NAS interruption, permission-change, capacity and 500,000-asset performance evidence.
Execute the Linux symbolic-link branch on the corresponding platform runner; no Windows result substitutes for that evidence.

The coordinator owns disposition of the nine documented sandbox directory remnants. Preserve the automatic approval rejection; this task must not bypass it or imply Git cleanliness means the runtime sandbox is empty.
